name: @red-cup-engineering/relation-model-notation-json-codec
description: The JSON<->Term bridge for Relation Model Notation: jsonToTerm/termToJson admit/decode JSON values against the RMN grammar, plus the fixed-shape builder API (objectTerm/arrayTerm/stringTerm/projectField/objectTy/arrayTy) for terms and types authored directly, without a runtime field search.
